svg.title: Where copies of your data live inside an SSD
svg.desc: The drive's flash drawn as one bar in four parts: current data, which the host can address; stale copies left behind by overwrites and garbage collection; the spare area kept for over-provisioning; and retired blocks. Three brackets below show what reaches what. Delete and Trim reach only the current data, and even there they only change what the host sees. Sanitize with block erase reaches all four parts. Crypto erase makes all four unreadable by destroying the key that encrypted them.
svg.text: where copies of your data live inside an SSD
delete and Trim reach only this
Sanitize, block erase: reaches all of it
crypto erase: makes all of it unreadable
